key_points: Nvidia announced a historic $150B share buyback increase, raising total repurchases to $235B through FY2028
Buyback seen as strong signal of confidence and will likely boost earnings per share and support price
New AI safety platform adds a strategic product differentiation amid growing AI regulation concerns
Market sentiment overwhelmingly positive with multiple outlets highlighting the buyback and price rally
No earnings or guidance shift, so impact is limited to capital allocation and investor sentiment
